verktyg.beskrivning: Get the shadcn CLI add command for specific items in a registry. This is useful for adding one or more components to your project.

items.description: Array of items to get the add command for prefixed with the registry name (e.g., ['@shadcn/button', '@shadcn/card'])

verktyg.beskrivning: After creating new components or generating new code files, use this tool for a quick checklist to verify that everything is working as expected. Make sure to run the tool after all required steps have been completed.
Find usage examples and demos with their complete code. Search for patterns like 'accordion-demo', 'button example', 'card-demo', etc. Returns full implementation code with dependencies.

query.description: Search query for examples (e.g., 'accordion-demo', 'button demo', 'card example', 'tooltip-demo', 'example-booking-form', 'example-hero'). Common patterns: '{item-name}-demo', '{item-name} example', 'example {item-name}'

registries.description: Array of registry names to search (e.g., ['@shadcn', '@acme']). Omit to search every registry configured in components.json.

verktyg.beskrivning: Get configured registry names from components.json - Returns error if no components.json exists (use init_project to create one)
List items from registries (requires components.json - use init_project if missing)

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (defaults to 100; use 0 for no limit)

offset.description: Number of items to skip for pagination

registries.description: Array of registry names to list (e.g., ['@shadcn', '@acme']). Omit to list from every registry configured in components.json.

types.description: Filter by item type. One of: lib, block, component, ui, hook, page, file, theme, style, item, base, font.

verktyg.beskrivning: Search for components in registries using fuzzy matching (requires components.json). After finding an item, use get_item_examples_from_registries to see usage examples.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (defaults to 100; use 0 for no limit)

offset.description: Number of items to skip for pagination

query.description: Search query string for fuzzy matching against item names and descriptions

registries.description: Array of registry names to search (e.g., ['@shadcn', '@acme']). Omit to search every registry configured in components.json.

types.description: Filter by item type. One of: lib, block, component, ui, hook, page, file, theme, style, item, base, font.

verktyg.beskrivning: View detailed information about specific registry items including the name, description, type and files content. For usage examples, use get_item_examples_from_registries instead.

items.description: Array of item names with registry prefix (e.g., ['@shadcn/button', '@shadcn/card'])
